description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Trello action by its ID.

display.description: Determines whether to include display-related information.
display.title: Display

entities.description: Determines whether to include related entities in the response.
entities.title: Entities

fields.description: Specifies which fields to include in the response. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'data', 'date', 'idMemberCreator', or 'type'.
fields.title: Fields

idAction.description: The ID of the action to retrieve.
idAction.title: Id Action

member.description: Determines whether to include member details.
member.title: Member

memberCreator.description: Determines whether to include details of the member who created the action.
memberCreator.title: Member Creator

memberCreator_fields.description: Specifies which fields of the member creator to include. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'avatarHash', 'bio', 'bioData', 'confirmed', 'fullName', 'idPremOrgsAdmin', 'initials', 'memberType', 'products', 'status', 'url', or 'username'.
memberCreator_fields.title: Member Creator Fields

member_fields.description: Specifies which member fields to include. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list of: 'avatarHash', 'bio', 'bioData', 'confirmed', 'fullName', 'idPremOrgsAdmin', 'initials', 'memberType', 'products', 'status', 'url', or 'username'.
member_fields.title: Member Fields
